lines.english: "…Is that Haruki?"
"Hey, do you know why I joined the Light Music Club?"
"Haruki dragged you into it, right? Takeya said something like that."
"I was standing here one day, overlooking the schoolyard… and heard White Album being played…"
"That sounds too good to be true."
"It was a guitar-piano duet. Their tone matched really well, and it sounded like they were really having fun."
"That's why before I realized it, I started singing because I felt like I wanted to join them too."
"I see…"
"It was the first time I wanted to join other people by my own will since enrolling in this school…"
"Even though you're pretty popular, Setsuna, you're actually kind of bad at socializing with others, huh? Guys are one thing, but you seemed to have trouble with girls too."
"Even so, you've always talked to me without any reservations, Io. I can say that I'm really happy about that right now, you know?"
"You really are pursuing demanding friendships. You're basically saying you'll only ever show your smile to those who overcome this high wall, you know?"
"Well, if they've made it that far, that means our friendship wouldn't be easily broken, right?"
"…But I guess that's arrogant of me."
"Arrogant indeed."
"…Thank you. That's why I'm really glad to have you as a friend, Io."
"That said, Setsuna, you still haven't told me why you've been so down lately."
"…It's nothing interesting. It really is just a pointless, little memory."
"Really now…"
"But…"
"Setsuna?"
"I did it again. Why did it turn out like this…?"
"It wasn't supposed to be like this, not like this."
"It's not your fault, Setsuna. There's no way her going to study abroad is any of your fault."
"You're really scary, Io. Maybe I shouldn't say any more…"
"It's all Haruki's fault. He completely ignored your feelings and acted rashly, Setsuna…"
"I was actually the one who made the first move."
"Eh…"
"On the night of the school festival, after I parted with you, Io… Soon after getting to the music room…"
"But why? I mean, Setsuna, back then you were…"
"N-No, even so. That has nothing to do with what's going on now, right?"
"Then why did you say it was Haruki-kun's fault, Io?"
"That doesn't matter. It can't possibly be your fault, Setsuna."
"You're not answering my question, you know?"
"The fact that you and Haruki are dating and the fact that that girl's leaving to study abroad have nothing to do with each other, Setsuna!"
"…You really think so?"
"There's no way she would decide her future just because of that. It's just like she said, it's all for the piano and her mother!"
"Kazusa… has been really good at hiding it. But I already know what it is she's hiding."
"I'm telling you, Setsuna, you're just imagining things."
"Even if I am… I'm still sad about it nonetheless."
"Running away after being rejected by a boy in this day and age would just be too embarrassing, you know… Way too serious, don't you think? There's just no way."
"It wasn't supposed to… turn out like this…"
